def pack(s:readbuf, o:mutbuf, w:mutbuf) -> u32:

        return 4294967295
    if get(s, 8) != 226033:
        return 4294967295
    if get(s, 16) != 262876:

        return 4294967295

        return 4294967295
    if length(o) < 1648234:

    prefix_3(o)

    store(o, 231251, 0)

    store(o, 791846, 0)
    store(o, 791847, 0)

    store(o, 791853, 0)

    store(o, 791855, 0)
    index = 0
    while index < 226033:
        store(o, 5216 + index, byte(s, 48 + index))
        index = index + 1
    index = 0

        store(o, 231264 + index, byte(s, 226081 + index))
        index = index + 1
    index = 0

def get(s:readbuf, at:u64) -> u64:
    result = 0
    i = 0
    while i < 8:
        result = result | (byte(s, at + i) << (i * 8))
        i = i + 1
    return result
def put(o:mutbuf, at:u64, value:u64) -> u64:
    i = 0
    while i < 8:
        store(o, at + i, value & 255)
        value = value >> 8
        i = i + 1
    return 0
